title: Executive summary
intro: Spending, budget, speed and control for the period you choose. Select a number to see the documents behind it.
scopeDept: Showing only the departments you head
forbidden: This page is for people who can view reports: executives, finance, procurement, auditors and department heads.

notices.periodInvalid: The dates in the link cannot be used, so the last 30 days are shown. Choose a new period in the filters.
notices.department: The department in the link is outside your access, so all departments you can see are shown.
notices.type: The request type in the link was not found, so all types are shown.

attentionNone: Nothing needs attention in this period

spend.title: Spending
spend.label: Approved POs in the period, before VAT
spend.empty: No POs approved in this period yet
spend.priceAlerts: POs with a unit price more than {pct}% above the last one: {count}

budget.title: Budget
budget.label: Used (committed and actual) of the planned budget
budget.none: No fiscal year covers the last day of this period yet
budget.chartTitle: Reserved, committed and actual by department
budget.unit: Unit: % of the department's planned budget
budget.typeIgnored: The request type filter does not apply to budgets, because budget lines are not split by type.

speed.title: Speed
speed.label: Median time from request submitted to first PO approved
speed.none: No requests got a PO in this period yet
speed.decision: Median decision time per step {hours} business hours from {count} steps
speed.decisionNone: No steps were decided in this period yet
speed.chartTitle: Median decision time per step, weekly for 12 weeks
speed.unit: Unit: business hours, weeks start on Monday
speed.idle: POs without activity for more than {days} days: {count}

control.title: Control
control.label: Decisions citing the DOA in full
control.none: No decisions in this period yet
control.overBudget: Approval tasks of requests over budget: {count}
control.unit: Unit: % of decisions in the period
control.missing: Decisions not citing the DOA in full: {count}

titles.price-alerts: POs with a unit price above the last one
titles.submit-to-po: Requests whose first PO was approved in the period
titles.doa-ref: Decisions citing the DOA in full
titles.doa-missing: Decisions not citing the DOA in full
titles.over-budget: Approval tasks of requests over budget

list.weekOf: Steps decided in the week starting {date}
